budget_arithmetic.comparison: 2017Q3 reported budget to date minus 2017Q2 reported budget to date
budget_arithmetic.interpretation: These numbers match arithmetically. They do not prove when an amendment took effect, why budgets changed, or how individual transactions were posted. The Q3 report shows a zero period budget despite its higher to-date budget. Preserve both source vintages.

limits: Federal allocation, approved plan amount, HUD obligation, QPR programmed budget, QPR activity obligations and beneficiary allocations are distinct and must not be added or substituted.
The 2013 news releases do not print the grant ID; the linkage is cross-source and does not establish the exact version or the date of the later Plan A approval.
The June 2018 HUD report covers obligations with extended disbursement deadlines; it is not a complete ledger and does not verify a later $7.99 million obligation or its date.
Program income received and drawdowns are not expenditure. Subtracting income from budget is a diagnostic, not a reconstructed expenditure or certified historical allocation.

Descriptive QPR total-funds-expended / reported award ratios are supplied with source vintage and program-income warnings. Certified federal-only Q12 and Q20 expenditure-to-allocation outcomes remain unavailable; no Q1 baseline or beneficiary split is inferred.
event_identity_policy: Announcement rows without an original source grant ID retain source details but do not assert an award identity.
